rows.text: P1: define the transaction boundary for predicate-based edge requirements. Externally driven predicate invalidation can make an existing edge invalid outside any operation the engine can reject. Restrict edge-constraint dependencies to transactionally tracked engine state, or require external values to enter the validated transaction before influencing constraints. Component removal/property edits must revalidate affected existing edges, not only new edges.

Independent subagent migration_plan_review: the engine-first sequence, repeated component instances, owner-defined predicates, scoped lazy views and compiler/runtime checkpoints are coherent. Add focused proof cases for negative/enumerated dependencies, changed predicate branches, isolated candidate caches on rejected transactions and subscription disposal. This is a plan review; no implementation or test results are validated.
